approval_evidence.quote: This letter hereby issues ... U.S. License No. 1574 to Serono, Incorporated ... Interferon beta-1a is indicated for the treatment of patients with relapsing forms of multiple sclerosis ... your product will bear the proprietary name Rebif (FDA CBER letter dated March 7, 2002)

series_start_reason: Series starts at the first quarter (2018Q1) for which the issuer's own report prints Rebif on a 'thereof: Rebif' line of the Healthcare product table. Rebif was approved in the U.S. in 2002 (FDA letter), well before the series start, and Merck KGaA's 2014-2017 quarterly reports do print Rebif quarterly sales (EUR million, e.g. 'Sales and organic growth of Rebif and Erbitux by region' tables, total column), but there the value sits on a different text line from the label 'Rebif' (and in 2015-2017 only in a chart or text paragraph), so a row cannot be tied to one printed line the verifier can read; those years are left out rather than quoted loosely.
notes: Net sales of Rebif worldwide, Merck KGaA, Darmstadt, Germany (Healthcare sector, Neurology & Immunology, 'thereof' line; EUR million). Currency EUR. Precision is whole EUR million to 2022Q4 (Q4 derived, approximate) and one decimal from 2023Q1. Pre-2018 quarters exist in the issuer's 2014-2017 reports but are not included (see series_start_reason).
